competitor_analysis.update_frequency: Annual for data reports; Bi-annual for inspections

proposed_firecrawl_metrics.description: A calculated score based on public state inspection reports, weighing frequency and severity of violations to surface risk-adjusted facility comparisons.
proposed_firecrawl_metrics.data_source_type: State regulatory PDFs and public inspection report portals
proposed_firecrawl_metrics.data_freshness_risk: High - state reports are updated bi-annually but new violations can occur anytime.
proposed_firecrawl_metrics.authority_impact: Positions assistedly.ai as a translator of dense regulatory filings into actionable consumer scores.

proposed_firecrawl_metrics.description: Combining base rent with Level 1-4 care fees extracted from facility websites to expose all-in monthly costs rather than advertised starting rates.
proposed_firecrawl_metrics.data_source_type: Facility websites, pricing pages, and PDF rate sheets
proposed_firecrawl_metrics.data_freshness_risk: Medium - pricing changes typically occur annually but discounts are seasonal.
proposed_firecrawl_metrics.authority_impact: Reveals hidden costs that referral sites smooth over, building direct consumer trust.

proposed_firecrawl_metrics.description: Real-time tracking of whether a facility currently accepts Senior Care Options or PACE slots based on program enrollment pages and provider directories.
proposed_firecrawl_metrics.data_source_type: MassHealth program pages, provider directories, plan websites
proposed_firecrawl_metrics.data_freshness_risk: High - Medicaid waiver slots are limited and fill quickly.
proposed_firecrawl_metrics.authority_impact: Solves a high-intent, high-anxiety search query that no single aggregator currently answers accurately.

proposed_firecrawl_metrics.description: Tracks sudden changes in listed staff roles and leadership on facility websites (e.g., new Director of Nursing within 6 months, dropped CNA hiring posts) to serve as an early proxy for staffing instability before it appears in state records.
proposed_firecrawl_metrics.data_source_type: Facility careers pages, leadership pages, and job board postings
proposed_firecrawl_metrics.data_freshness_risk: Medium - turnover spikes correlate to inspection findings but are faster to detect via crawl.
proposed_firecrawl_metrics.authority_impact: Predictive signal that surfaces risks before state inspections, differentiating from backward-looking directories.

proposed_firecrawl_metrics.description: Derived from the gap between total licensed units (from public EOEA data) and 'move-in specials' or 'limited availability' language on facility websites to indicate consumer negotiation leverage.
proposed_firecrawl_metrics.data_source_type: Public state certified-bed counts crossed with facility website promotional language
proposed_firecrawl_metrics.data_freshness_risk: Medium - availability messaging changes with census but bed counts are relatively static.
proposed_firecrawl_metrics.authority_impact: Translates public capacity data into a practical consumer bargaining signal.

feature_recommendations.functionality: A 0-100 score per facility combining aggregated public inspection histories, staffing signals, and complaint volume from state ombudsman sources. Includes trend-line (improving vs. declining) and comparison to county average.
feature_recommendations.authority_impact: Turns scattered state filings into a standardized, consumer-friendly metric no directory currently offers.
feature_recommendations.data_dependency: Aggregation of public EOEA inspection records, facility staffing pages, and ombudsman reports.

feature_recommendations.functionality: User inputs income/assets to determine eligibility for MA-specific Medicaid programs and surfaces which facilities in their area currently have open program slots.
feature_recommendations.authority_impact: Bridges the gap between eligibility rules and real-time provider enrollment, reducing friction in a high-stakes decision process.
feature_recommendations.data_dependency: Public MassHealth eligibility thresholds and crawl of participating provider listings.

feature_recommendations.functionality: When a family views a facility with recent public citations, the system surfaces tailored questions to ask during tours (e.g., 'Ask about their current med-pass audit process').
feature_recommendations.authority_impact: Positions assistedly.ai as an advocacy platform rather than a passive directory.
feature_recommendations.data_dependency: Indexed public inspection citations mapped to generated consumer advocacy prompts.

local_market_differentiators.value: Boston vs. Fall River price disparity (~$2k/mo diff)

medicaid_waiver_complexity.value: MA uses SCO and PACE which are integrated Medicare/Medicaid programs; eligibility varies by ASAP region.

geographic_clustering.value: High density in Greater Boston/Middlesex County; care deserts in rural Western MA/Berkshires.

authority_ownership_matrix.path_to_authority: Move beyond median market rates to facility-specific True Cost Matrices (base rent + care levels) refreshed monthly.
Aggregate and standardize public inspection reports into searchable, trended risk scores.
Add real-time participating provider slot availability to general eligibility rules.

target_domains.rationale: Primary source for certification, inspection reports, and program rules.
Trade association with provider lists and payment guides.
Aging Services Access Points with local provider relationships.
Pricing, staffing, and availability language change frequently.

crawl_execution_strategy.crawl_depth: Deep (to capture PDF inspection reports and nested pricing pages)

tier_1_urgent.description: Data gaps that directly impact user trust and conversion features.
targets: Facility websites for current pricing + care level fees
MassHealth SCO/PACE participating provider pages for slot availability
State inspection report PDF release pages

tier_2_moat_widening.description: Data competitors rarely index but could theoretically replicate; first-mover advantage matters.
targets: Hospital discharge planner resource pages (partnership mapping)
Facility careers pages for staffing signals

tier_3_long_tail.description: SEO and content gap opportunities with lower immediate conversion impact but high authority ceiling.
targets: City/town council meeting minutes mentioning zoning approvals for new ALRs
Alzheimer's Association MA chapter event listings

crawl_execution_strategy.data_freshness_strategy: Crawl larger providers (Benchmark, Atria, Brightview) weekly for promotional changes; monitor state EOEA pages for new report PDF uploads; alert on inspection report page modifications.

pdf_sources.firecrawl_status: Requires /scrape with PDF handling enabled or separate parser pipeline
pdf_sources.fallback: Direct download via scheduled script, parse with pdfplumber, and push structured data to database.

pdf_sources.firecrawl_status: Often PDF or document attachments; may require custom extraction
pdf_sources.fallback: Monitor download links and process via document parsing service.

javascript_heavy_sites.site: A Place for Mom facility detail pages
javascript_heavy_sites.firecrawl_status: Heavy JS rendering for pricing and availability
javascript_heavy_sites.fallback: Use /scrape with waitFor selector or target underlying API endpoints if discoverable.
Target sitemap XML for static metadata; supplement with manual pricing survey for top facilities.

firecrawl_limitations_and_fallbacks.rate_limiting_considerations: Mass.gov and .gov sites generally tolerate moderate crawl rates but should be throttled to 1 req/sec during business hours. Facility sites can be crawled more aggressively.

data_journalism_opportunities.content_type: Annual Massachusetts ALR Safety Landscape Report
data_journalism_opportunities.description: Data journalism analyzing publicly available state inspection trends by county, surfacing counties with the highest citation categories. Unreplicable without deep aggregation of public EOEA filings.
data_journalism_opportunities.seo_value: High - attracts .gov and .edu backlinks and local press coverage.
data_journalism_opportunities.data_sources_needed: Aggregated public EOEA inspection data and county-level demographic sources.

data_journalism_opportunities.description: Notifications when publicly available state records indicate critical or repeat violations at MA facilities, published as breaking consumer alerts.
data_journalism_opportunities.seo_value: Engagement and retention play; builds subscription habit.
